newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kerry Prop loan increased to HK$4.0 bln.
newsitem.headline: Kerry Prop loan increased to HK$4.0 bln.

text.p: Kerry Properties Ltd's unsecured five-year term loan facility has been increased to HK$4.0 billion from HK$3.6 billion due to oversubscription, the coordinating arrangers said on Tuesday.

The facility is divided into two tranches. Tranche A is denominated in Hong Kong dollars and tranche B is denominated in U.S. dollars. Interest margins are 0.75 percent per annum for tranche A and 0.70 percent for tranche B.
Proceeds of the loan will be used to fund the general corporate requirements of Kerry Properties Ltd and its group companies.

Arrangers and lead managers are Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp, Chase Manhattan Asia, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia, ABN AMRO Bank, CIBC CEF, Dresdner Bank Hong Kong Branch, Fuji Bank, Industrial Bank of Japan Hong Kong Branch, Sakura Bank, Societe Generale Asia and Sumitomo Bank.
Co-arrangers and expanded lead managers are Sanwa Bank Hong Kong Branch, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Hong Kong Branch and Tokai Bank Hong Kong Branch.
Co-lead managers are Bayerische Vereinsbank Hong Kong Branch and Mitsubishi Trust & Banking Corp Hong Kong Branch.
Managers are Banque Nationale de Paris Hong Kong Branch, Daiwa Securities (HK), Development Bank of Singapore, National Australia Bank Hong Kong Branch and Toyo Trust & Banking Co's Hong Kong Branch.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia and Chase Manhattan Asia were the bookrunners. J.P. Morgan Securities Asia handled documentation and ABN AMRO Bank is the facility agent.
